highcraft.configuration.title: HighCraft Configuration
jei.highcraft.info.addiction: Addiction & tolerance: each dose increases tolerance (shorter effects) and addiction. With high addiction, withdrawal sets in after a while without use. Intoxication above 100 causes an overdose – above 170 is lethal. Detox tea helps.
jei.highcraft.info.bong: Fill with water, pack with cannabis, tobacco or opium and take a hit with an empty hand (lighter in inventory).
jei.highcraft.info.cannabis: Cannabis grows on farmland and becomes two blocks tall from stage 4. Right-click mature plants to harvest – they regrow. Seeds drop from grass and wild cannabis (plains, savanna) or can be bought from the Grower.
jei.highcraft.info.chemical_reactor: Heats three reagents (fuel or FE). Needs a fume hood or exhaust fan within 4 blocks: without ventilation it releases toxic fumes (poisoning everyone nearby without a gas mask), batches can explode and the quality drops. With ventilation the quality rises.
jei.highcraft.info.coca: The coca bush grows on dirt, grass or farmland and loves warm climates (jungle, savanna). Pick leaves with right-click from stage 3.
jei.highcraft.info.crystallizer: Crystallizes raw batches. Needs cold: ice, packed ice, blue ice, snow or powder snow in the coolant slot, or FE power. Packed or blue ice next to it (deep cold) runs it for free at full speed; a cold biome or plain ice runs it at half speed. Deep cold adds +1 quality.
jei.highcraft.info.detox_tea: Halves addiction and tolerance for all substances and ends withdrawal and overdose.
jei.highcraft.info.drug_test: Shows your intoxication, addiction and tolerance for each substance.
jei.highcraft.info.drying_rack: Right-click with plant parts to hang them up (max. 4). Dries faster in warm biomes and sunshine, pauses in rain. Right-click with an empty hand to take finished goods. Works with hoppers.
jei.highcraft.info.ecstasy: Ecstasy: warm euphoria, hearts everywhere and the world pulses to the beat. Slowly heals you but makes you hungry; followed by a comedown. Tolerance builds quickly.
jei.highcraft.info.ergot: Ergot sometimes infests mature wheat (about 5%% when harvesting). Rarely sold by the wandering trader and the Dealer. Turn it into LSD solution in the chemistry lab with reagent and solvent.
jei.highcraft.info.fertilizer: On HighCraft crops: +1 growth stage, +50%% growth speed and +1 harvest quality. Acts like bone meal on other plants.
jei.highcraft.info.gas_mask: Protects against toxic lab fumes. The full hazmat set (gas mask, suit, pants, boots) also makes you immune to lab accidents.
jei.highcraft.info.grow_lamp: Bright light that speeds up crops up to 5 blocks below (5×5). Counts as ideal light for harvest quality and lights nearby grow tents.
jei.highcraft.info.grow_tent: Two blocks tall (needs a free block above). Grows crops independent of weather: insert seeds, water buckets and optionally fertilizer. Light comes from FE power, a nearby grow lamp, or open sky during the day. Hoppers and cables work on both halves.
jei.highcraft.info.lighter: Smokables, pipes and bongs need a lighter or flint and steel in your inventory.
jei.highcraft.info.lsd: LSD blotters cause a very long, kaleidoscopic trip. Barely addictive, but tolerance builds quickly.
jei.highcraft.info.machines: Machines run on fuel (like a furnace) or FE power. Hoppers and pipes: insert from top/sides, extract from the bottom.
jei.highcraft.info.meth: Crystal meth: snort it or smoke it in a glass pipe (stronger). Extremely addictive. While high you are fast and tireless and cannot sleep; afterwards comes a heavy comedown.
jei.highcraft.info.mushroom: Magic mushrooms grow in the dark on solid ground, or anywhere on mycelium and podzol, and spread slowly. Right-click mature clusters to harvest. Found wild in dark forests and swamps.
jei.highcraft.info.pill_press: Presses MDMA powder, sugar as a binder and a dye into four ecstasy pills. The dye decides the colour and stamp.
jei.highcraft.info.poppy: Opium poppies grow on farmland. Score mature pods with the scoring knife for raw opium, or break them for pods and seeds. You can also craft seeds from two poppies.
jei.highcraft.info.precision_scale: Job site of the Dealer. Right-click with goods to see weight and quality.
jei.highcraft.info.raw_opium: Harvested from mature poppies with the scoring knife, or extracted from poppy pods.
jei.highcraft.info.smoking_pipe: Automatically smokes cannabis, tobacco or opium from your inventory.
jei.highcraft.info.tobacco: Tobacco grows on farmland. Right-click mature plants to harvest (they regrow). Dry, grind and roll the leaves into cigarettes, cigars or spliffs.
jei.highcraft.info.ventilation: Fume hoods and exhaust fans ventilate every chemical reactor within 4 blocks: no toxic fumes, no accidents and +1 quality.
